summary: Both current reports pass the independent content, citation, metadata, number, formula, protocol, resource and official-image review. One LR-V2X publication-status omission found on the initial snapshot was corrected and rechecked before this PASS was bound.
scopeBoundary: Independent review of the two assigned reports and four official images. No production report or image was edited by this reviewer. No Git operation, email, notification, subdelegation, experiment, model execution, checkpoint loading or dataset download was performed.

citationAxes: title, complete authors, author-unit mapping, version and publication status
claim-context support against the cited work's own primary source
method.primarySourcePolicy: The two reports were checked against fixed arXiv v1 HTML and PDF files. Every related-work mechanism was reopened in that work's own primary paper, and formal venue pages were checked when available. Current code, data, configuration and weight claims were checked separately on official repositories and provider pages.

authorEvidenceUse.note: The author artifact was used to locate fixed originals, cached primary related work, resource snapshots and official images. Its judgments were not accepted as review conclusions; the reviewer reopened the reports, source sections, live metadata/resources and actual image files independently.

initialFinding.finding: The initial report described NeurIPS 2026 acceptance only as author-reported and said no independent venue landing page had been verified, while the official NeurIPS Downloads 2026 directory listed LR-V2X and linked poster 148873.

source.evidence: The official directory was opened and searched for the exact title; its LR-V2X entry links poster 148873. Direct poster fetch was restricted in the review tool, so the report correctly distinguishes official acceptance-directory evidence from unverified proceedings publication.

initialFinding.requiredFix: Record NeurIPS 2026 acceptance as verified by the official directory and poster destination, retain the fixed arXiv v1 as the mechanism/numerical source, and keep formal proceedings publication unverified.

correctionRecheck.resolution: The current report records official NeurIPS 2026 acceptance, cites the official directory and poster destination, and explicitly says the formal proceedings page was not verified. No mechanism, numerical result or fixed-version source changed.

papers.taxonomyCheck: The sole cooperative-autonomous-driving topic matches a cooperative LiDAR 3D-detection method. The report does not add testing, planning, security or other unsupported secondary topics.
papers.publicationStatus: arXiv:2610.08573v1 preprint, submitted 2026-10-06. The PDF's JOURNAL OF LATEX CLASS FILES header is a template header, not publication evidence; no formal venue destination was verified.

claimChecks.mechanismAndFormula: PASS: object-wise sampling has K_o=floor((1-r_o)N_o) with no positive floor; V_rec=V\V_drop and the missing set combine intentional and link loss; reconstruction MSE, train/inference source switch for flow warping, future-frame cosine supervision, residual-offset field, bilinear sampling, clean-transform self-supervision and the four-term total loss all preserve the original symbols and information boundary.
claimChecks.datasetsAndProtocol: PASS: DAIR-V2X real V2I/Car, OpenV2V simulated V2V/vehicle and V2V4Real real two-vehicle data with vehicle types merged are distinct. AP@0.5 and AP@0.7 are percentage metrics with higher better. Clean, individual packet-loss/delay/misalignment and Mixed conditions are kept separate. Loss ratio U(0,0.9), 200 ms delay, N(0,3 degrees) rotation and N(0,0.5) m translation are preserved, including the source's unresolved Gaussian second-parameter meaning.
claimChecks.mainNumbers: PASS: DAIR Mixed 58.10/39.54 versus Where2comm 37.95/27.75 gives +20.15/+11.79 AP points and 2.6 versus 12.9 Mbps. Mixed CoDynTrust comparisons are 42.35/30.17 versus 58.10/39.54, 81.15/70.42 versus 88.28/74.53, and 45.07/25.81 versus 56.18/33.15, with 10.6% versus 1.0% relative feature volume. Delay-only AP@0.7 is 47.94 versus How2comm 48.13, and clean OpenV2V 93.70/87.66 trails CoSDH 94.20/88.19.
claimChecks.ablations: PASS: baseline/SFE/LAA/SCF/all noisy AP@0.5 values 37.95/49.91/41.67/48.53/58.10, joint versus multi-stage 49.40/58.10, random versus object-aware 56.23/58.10, and random-mask-plus-pose baseline 45.47 versus full 58.10 match Tables III-VI. The report correctly retains model-capacity and optimization-budget confounding.
claimChecks.latencyAndCommunication: PASS: 34.0M parameters, 326.4 GFLOPs and 69.7 ms are profiled model quantities. The 26.0 ms network component is calculated from 2.6 Mbps, 10 Hz and a nominal 10 Mbps link, yielding 95.7 ms total; 74.9 ms is the 50 Mbps calculation. The report does not call either value an actual radio or end-to-end road measurement.
claimChecks.trainingAndUncertainty: PASS: the three-stage training description and reported Adam/AdamW settings match the source, while missing freeze details, loss weights, split manifests, hardware and multi-seed intervals remain explicit limitations.
claimChecks.negativeAndScopeClaims: PASS: the report preserves clean-setting and delay counterexamples, separates Mixed from individual disturbances, and makes no actual-wireless, closed-loop driving or safety-guarantee claim.
claimChecks.followUp: PASS: the equal-byte, equal-checkpoint target-erasure study specifies controls, AP/recall/false-positive endpoints, at least three paired seeds, success criteria and a stop/redirect rule.

claimChecks.mechanismAndFormula: PASS: a spatial Bernoulli reception mask is shared across channels; LPD maps the received 16x32x64 latent through four overlapping transposed-convolution layers; the source equation for Gaussian noising, x0 prediction with received latent, ego BEV and transform conditioning, and stage-3 detection plus 0.1 reconstruction loss are preserved. Fixed t=700 means one denoising forward pass, not 700 iterations.
claimChecks.datasetsAndProtocol: PASS: DAIR-V2X val is V2I and V2XREAL test is LiDAR-only V2V, both with two parties. All methods use PointPillars and complete-communication training; collaborator messages alone receive fixed-seed test masks while the ego feature remains local. DAIR overall mAP is full-range rather than a range-bin mean; V2XREAL mAP averages unrounded vehicle, pedestrian and truck AP.
claimChecks.budgetAndUnits: PASS: 16x32x64 float32 is 131,072 bytes or 128 KiB; 128x256x64 float32 is 8 MiB. The 64x value is a pre-loss tensor-byte ratio, not measured throughput. Payload is per collaborator frame before loss; at 90% loss expected retained compact payload is about 12.8 KiB.
claimChecks.iidAndCleanComparisons: PASS: DAIR 90% i.i.d. CodeFilling 63.38/60.93/50.62 at 9.17 FPS and LR-V2X 69.35/66.90/53.37 at 6.04 FPS are both 128 KiB. Budget-matched CoBEVT is 67.73/62.85/52.99 at 5.30 FPS, so LR-V2X leads by 1.62/4.05/0.38 points. V2XREAL CodeFilling 40.54/36.69/23.16 at 1.68 FPS and LR-V2X 44.87/38.60/24.18 at 1.54 FPS give +1.91/+1.02 at IoU 0.5/0.7. The report separates these degraded tests from clean references and does not treat every low-loss curve point as a win.
claimChecks.burstCounterexample: PASS: the spatially correlated mask is sampled on an 8x16 coarse grid at retention 0.1 and nearest-neighbor resized; it is not a temporal network burst. At 90% burst loss, 8 MiB F-Cooper 69.88/65.08/52.12 exceeds 128 KiB LR-V2X 67.83/64.21/51.93, while LR-V2X exceeds same-budget CodeFilling 65.36/62.62/51.48.
claimChecks.ablations: PASS: complete-communication conditioning ablation starts from the same latent prior, so 67.28 is not No Fusion; ego-only 78.90, ego+transform 79.69 and all conditions 81.03 match Table 5. The no-noise reconstructor retains LPD and a learned reconstructor; noise conditioning gains 7.16/7.22/4.23 points at 90% loss.
claimChecks.failuresAndEfficiency: PASS: V2XREAL pedestrian AP@0.5 12.23 trails CodeFilling 12.92 and HEAL 12.96; Figure 5 contains other low-loss leaders; 1.54 and 6.04 FPS do not establish a real-time road system. Hardware and multi-seed intervals are absent.
claimChecks.trainingBoundary: PASS: the 40/100/20 epoch, batch 8/12/8 and Adam 0.002/0.0002/0.0002 stages, frozen sensor backbone in stage 3, DiT-B 12 layers/768 hidden/12 heads and complete-message training match Appendix A. Packet loss is introduced only at evaluation.
claimChecks.negativeAndScopeClaims: PASS: two-party spatial erasure experiments are not described as measured wireless delivery, congestion, retransmission, temporal outage, larger cooperative graphs, closed-loop driving or safety validation.
claimChecks.followUp: PASS: the conditional-DiT study fixes checkpoint, sample set, paired masks and 128 KiB budget; tests i.i.d. and coarse-grid burst loss; stratifies overlap; records AP, recall, false positives, P50/P95 latency and invocation rate; and has numerical success and stop criteria.
